lines.speaker: narrator
lines.textEn: "What happened here?" Wukong asked the gibbon.
lines.textZh: "这里发生了什么?"悟空问着那只长臂猿。
lines.audioRef: sent_en:"What happened here?" Wukong asked the gibbon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.textEn: "A demon attacked us," said the gibbon.
lines.textZh: "有个恶魔袭击了我们,"长臂猿说道。
lines.audioRef: sent_en:"A demon attacked us," said the gibbon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.textEn: "Wait here," Wukong ordered. "I will handle the demon."
lines.textZh: "请在此等候,"悟空命令道,"我来对付那妖怪。"
lines.audioRef: sent_en:"Wait here," Wukong ordered. "I will handle the demon."

question.textEn: why did wukong go after the demon?
question.textZh: 悟空为什么要去追那个妖怪？

options.feedback: 对了，悟空是去救被抓走的猴子。

options.textEn: to show how powerful he is
options.feedback: 再想想，他是因为猴子被绑架才去的。

options.textEn: to be friends with the demon
options.feedback: 再想想，他是因为猴子被绑架才去的。
